visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on an outdoor rooftop terrace with a wooden floor and brown structural beams overhead. A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a navy varsity jacket and pink clogs, excitedly points at the city view and asks her friend to take photos. The friend, wearing a black beret and a light blue shirt, looks overwhelmed as she holds a smartphone. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the smartphone screen, revealing a cluttered interface with numerous app folders and a Gmail icon showing over 24,000 unread notifications. A finger scrolls through the disorganized screen. (3) A young man with brown hair in a beige shirt enters the scene, presenting a small brown essential oil roller bottle to the camera. He then applies the oil to the temples of the woman in the beret while she closes her eyes. Transitioning back to her, she looks refreshed with pink heart graphics surrounding her face. (4) The setting shifts to an indoor living room with a white sofa. The man is sitting on the sofa, holding his phone and looking frustrated at a group chat interface displayed as an overlay. The background is a plain white wall with a clock-patterned pillow. (5) The woman in the beret is now in a brightly lit retail store, Watsons, standing in front of a shelf displaying various beauty products. She holds up the MeetAngel essential oil gift set, demonstrating its four different roller bottles: Peppermint, Sweet Orange, Tea Tree, and Lavender. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (6) The three characters reunite in the store, smiling and holding the product boxes toward the camera. One woman gestures excitedly while the man gives a thumbs up, concluding with a celebratory and energetic pose.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal female voices yelling excitedly against a bright, upbeat synth-pop background track. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition as the female voice shifts to a stressed, higher-pitched tone. (2) Rapid mechanical 'click' SFX simulate scrolling on a phone, accompanied by a cartoonish 'thud' sound indicating a digital collapse. The BGM remains energetic but lowers in volume during dialogue. (3) A magical 'sparkle' SFX plays as the male speaker introduces the product with a clear, professional narrative tone. This is followed by a satisfying 'ding' sound. (4) The scene shifts with a percussive beat change. A male voice speaks in a casual, conversational tone, which quickly escalates into an exaggerated, comedic shout of frustration. (5) High-frequency 'pop' and 'magic' sound effects punctuate the description of various essential oil scents. The female speaker's voice is friendly and enunciated, typical of a promotional tutorial. (6) The final phase features all three voices cheering in unison, supported by a triumphant musical stinger and a final upbeat electronic chord, maintaining a high-energy advertising vibe.
